Net flow in that window was negative (-5.96 SOL), with sellers (60) outnumbering buyers (52) and sell SOL exceeding buy SOL. The first two minutes after graduation show a sell-to-buy ratio of 1.34, meaning early holders were already exiting. A launch bot was present, and the top five buyers took 34% of early volume.

The only constructive reads are that 104 early buyers and 36.6 SOL of early demand suggest some initial interest, and that the pool holds 61 SOL of depth, so liquidity is not thin. Neither offsets the trend. Demand that has already left at this rate is not demand that will still be here in 30 to 60 minutes.

Nothing in the brief shows a bundle-free curve, an operator backing, or a recovery signal. Symbol and name are null, so there is no identity to weigh. With the base rates and this price action, I have no case for buying now. Recommendation: skip.
